en.Situation: At my first internship, the enquiry form on a shop's campaign page broke on older Android phones and we only found out from a customer.
en.Task: I was asked to fix that form and to check the whole page on the phones our clients actually use.
en.Action: I rewrote the layout with a flexible grid, tested it on four borrowed handsets, and added a form test that submits an empty field.
en.Result: The form worked on all four phones, and we published a device list so the next release was checked the same way.
en.vague: The page had some display issues on phones for a while.
en.exaggerated: I rebuilt the entire site by myself and it has been perfect since.
en.no_data: The form worked after that and the customer stopped complaining.

zh.Situation: 第一份實習，一間小店宣傳頁嘅查詢表格喺舊 Android 機會爆版，我哋要靠客人通知才知道。
zh.Task: 我要修好個表格，並用客戶真正會用嘅手機檢查成頁。
zh.Action: 我用 flexible grid 重寫 layout，借四部手機逐部測，再加一個提交空欄位嘅 form test。
zh.Result: 四部機都正常，我哋之後仲寫低 device list，下次發佈照同樣方法檢查。
zh.vague: 個頁喺手機上有啲顯示問題，維持咗一段時間。
zh.exaggerated: 成個網站係我自己重寫，之後一直完美。
zh.no_data: 之後個表格正常，客人亦冇再投訴。

en.Situation: In my first full-time role we were building the same card layout three times because each page had its own copy of the CSS.
en.Task: I took on a small component library, and I had to agree the interface with the designer before writing it.
en.Action: I listed the five patterns we reused most, built them as one set of components, and demoed them in a short session with the designer.
en.Result: New pages went from about three days to one, and a colour change became a single edit instead of eleven.
en.vague: There was some duplication in the front-end and it slowed us down.
en.exaggerated: I designed the company's entire design system alone in two days.
en.no_data: After the change, building pages felt faster and changes were simpler.

zh.Situation: 第一份長工，我哋同一個 card layout 要做三次，因為每頁都有一份自己嘅 CSS。
zh.Task: 我接手做一個細型 component library，但要先同設計師講好 interface 才落手。
zh.Action: 我列出最常重用嘅五個 pattern，做成一組 component，再同設計師開個短 session 示範。
zh.Result: 新頁由大約三日變一日，改一個顏色由改十一處變成改一處。
zh.vague: front-end 有啲重複代碼，拖慢咗我哋。
zh.exaggerated: 公司成個 design system 係我兩日之內一個人做起的。
zh.no_data: 改完之後開頁好似快咗，改動亦簡單咗。

en.Situation: Three years in, an accessibility audit of our booking site found that keyboard users could not reach the date picker at all.
en.Task: I owned the fix for that flow, and I had to explain to the product owner why it was a release blocker.
en.Action: I rebuilt the picker with focus management, wrote a manual test script for keyboard only use, and walked the product owner through it.
en.Result: The audit's blocking issues went from nine to one, and keyboard testing became part of our release checklist.
en.vague: Accessibility was a topic and we had some findings from an audit.
en.exaggerated: I made the whole product fully accessible by myself in one sprint.
en.no_data: The picker became usable with a keyboard and the audit findings dropped.

zh.Situation: 做咗三年，我們個 booking 網站嘅 accessibility audit 發現，淨用鍵盤嘅用戶完全去唔到 date picker。
zh.Task: 我負責修好嗰個 flow，亦要向 product owner 解釋點解呢個係 blocker。
zh.Action: 我用 focus management 重寫 picker，寫一份只用鍵盤嘅手動測試腳本，再逐步示範俾 product owner 睇。
zh.Result: audit 嘅 blocking issue 由九個變一個，keyboard 測試亦加入咗發佈 checklist。
zh.vague: accessibility 係個題目，audit 都有啲發現。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個 sprint 之內令成個產品完全無障礙。
zh.no_data: picker 之後用鍵盤都用得到，audit 嘅發現亦少咗。

en.Situation: When we connected our listing page to a new product API, the page showed a blank grid whenever the service was slow.
en.Task: I was responsible for the page, and I needed it to behave sensibly when the API failed.
en.Action: I added loading and error states, capped retries at two, and tested the page with the response delayed on purpose.
en.Result: Support tickets about the empty grid stopped, and the API team got a clear error log from us when their service broke.
en.vague: The page had some issues when the backend was slow.
en.exaggerated: I fixed the API team's reliability problems from the front end.
en.no_data: The page behaved better afterwards and the tickets stopped.

zh.Situation: 我哋把 listing 頁接去新 product API 之後，只要服務慢，個頁就變空白。
zh.Task: 我負責嗰頁，要令 API 失敗時個頁都有合理反應。
zh.Action: 我加 loading 同 error state，retry 最多兩次，再故意延遲 response 去測個頁。
zh.Result: 關於空白 grid 嘅 ticket 停咗，API 服務出事時我哋亦交到清楚嘅 error log 俾佢哋。
zh.vague: backend 慢嘅時候個頁有啲問題。
zh.exaggerated: 我喺 front end 修好咗 API 團隊嘅可靠性問題。
zh.no_data: 之後個頁好好多，ticket 亦冇再開。

en.Situation: For a friend's tutoring business I built a one-page booking site, and the first version took nine seconds to load on mobile data.
en.Task: I set myself the goal of a page that loaded under three seconds on a normal phone connection.
en.Action: I compressed the images, removed two unused fonts, split the JavaScript, and measured each change with the browser network panel.
en.Result: Load time dropped to under three seconds on the same phone, and the owner got her first two bookings through the page.
en.vague: The site was slow at the beginning and I made it better.
en.exaggerated: I built a professional booking platform that competes with the big apps.
en.no_data: The page loads much faster now and the owner likes it.

zh.Situation: 我幫朋友嘅補習社做一頁式 booking 網站，第一版用手機數據要九秒才載入。
zh.Task: 我定咗目標：普通手機連線下要三秒之內載入。
zh.Action: 我壓縮圖片、刪咗兩個冇用嘅字體、拆分 JavaScript，每次改動都用 browser network panel 量度。
zh.Result: 同一部機嘅載入時間跌到三秒以下，老闆娘仲經個頁接到頭兩單 booking。
zh.vague: 個站一開始幾慢，我把佢改好啲。
zh.exaggerated: 我做咗個可以同大 app 比嘅專業 booking 平台。
zh.no_data: 個頁依家載入快好多，老闆娘都幾滿意。

en.Situation: About four years in, two client teams kept sending change requests after we had already frozen scope for the release.
en.Task: I wanted fewer late changes, and I had to get agreement from people who did not report to me.
en.Action: I arranged a fifteen-minute demo every Thursday, showed the current build, and logged each request with a decision and a date.
en.Result: Late change requests fell by roughly half over two months, and the release date held for three sprints in a row.
en.vague: There were quite a lot of change requests at that time.
en.exaggerated: I single-handedly ended all scope creep in the department.
en.no_data: The demos helped and we had fewer last-minute changes.

zh.Situation: 做咗大約四年，兩個 client team 喺我哋 freeze 咗範圍之後仍然不停送 change request。
zh.Task: 我想減少臨尾改動，但要拿到唔向我匯報嘅同事同意。
zh.Action: 我安排每個星期四十五分鐘 demo，展示當時嘅 build，每個 request 都記低決定同日期。
zh.Result: 兩個月內臨尾改動大約減半，發佈日期連續三個 sprint 都守得住。
zh.vague: 嗰時 change request 都幾多。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人令部門完全冇 scope creep。
zh.no_data: demo 有幫助，臨尾改動少咗。

en.Situation: At a digital agency, three clients shared one marketing template and each wanted a different header without paying for a custom build.
en.Task: I had to make the template configurable, and explain to the account team what a configuration actually costs to maintain.
en.Action: I added a small settings object with three variations, wrote a one-page guide, and showed the account team the build time for each option.
en.Result: All three clients launched on the same template, and the next client needed no new code.
en.vague: The template had to be changed for different clients and it was messy.
en.exaggerated: I built a template system the agency now uses for every single client.
en.no_data: After that the template worked for the clients and launches were easier.

zh.Situation: 喺一間數碼 agency，三個客戶共用一個宣傳 template，但每個都想改 header，又唔想另外付錢做 custom。
zh.Task: 我要令個 template 可設定，並向 account team 解釋每種設定嘅維護成本。
zh.Action: 我加咗一個細嘅 settings object，有三個變化，寫一頁指南，再向 account team 展示每個方案要幾多 build 時間。
zh.Result: 三個客戶都用同一個 template 上線，下一個客戶完全冇加 code。
zh.vague: 個 template 要為唔同客戶改，好亂。
zh.exaggerated: 我做咗一套 template 系統，agency 之後每個客都用。
zh.no_data: 之後個 template 用得成，上線都易咗。

en.Situation: In my first job, the checkout page broke every time we changed a currency label, because the total was rebuilt from a string.
en.Task: I was asked to make the total reliable, and to leave a check that would fail if anyone repeated the mistake.
en.Action: I kept the amount as a number until the last step, added a formatting function, and wrote tests with three currencies and one rounding case.
en.Result: The rounding bug stopped appearing, and the label change no longer touched the calculation.
en.vague: The checkout page had some bugs around the price display.
en.exaggerated: I rewrote the checkout and made it completely bug-free.
en.no_data: After the change the price display stopped going wrong.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，每次改貨幣標籤 checkout 頁就出事，因為總數係由字串重建出嚟。
zh.Task: 我要令總數可靠，並留低一個檢查，將來有人重犯就會 fail。
zh.Action: 我令金額到最後一步都保持數字，加一個 formatting function，再寫三個貨幣加一個四捨五入個案嘅測試。
zh.Result: 四捨五入嘅 bug 冇再出現，改標籤亦唔會再影響計算。
zh.vague: checkout 頁喺價錢顯示方面有啲 bug。
zh.exaggerated: 我重寫咗 checkout，令佢完全冇 bug。
zh.no_data: 改完之後價錢冇再顯示錯。

en.Situation: Four years in at an in-house team, the marketing site and the product app had drifted into two different button styles and two font sizes.
en.Task: I wanted one shared set of styles, and I needed the product team to give up their own copy without a fight.
en.Action: I measured both pages, showed the difference side by side, and proposed adopting the product team's tokens as the base.
en.Result: We shipped one token file in two sprints, and design review time dropped because there was less to argue about.
en.vague: The two sites looked different and people kept mentioning it.
en.exaggerated: I unified the whole company's design language on my own.
en.no_data: After that the sites looked more consistent and reviews were quicker.

zh.Situation: 喺 in-house 團隊做咗四年，marketing 站同產品 app 已經變成兩套 button 同兩套字級。
zh.Task: 我想有一套共用 style，但要產品團隊肯放低自己嗰份而唔係吵一場。
zh.Action: 我量度兩邊頁面，並排展示差異，再提出以產品團隊嘅 token 做基礎。
zh.Result: 兩個 sprint 出咗一個共用 token 檔，design review 因為少咗爭論而快咗。
zh.vague: 兩個站睇落唔同，同事不停提。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人統一咗公司成個 design language。
zh.no_data: 之後兩個站一致咗，review 都快咗。

en.Situation: At a web agency, a client's booking form sent duplicate enquiries for about a month and the client blamed the design.
en.Task: I had to find the real cause and explain it clearly enough that the client stopped blaming the build.
en.Action: I reproduced it with a slow connection, found the submit button stayed active during the request, and disabled it with a visible state.
en.Result: Duplicate enquiries stopped, and the client's own network was shown to be timing out separately.
en.vague: There were duplicate enquiries and the client was unhappy.
en.exaggerated: I proved the client was wrong and fixed everything myself.
en.no_data: After the fix the duplicates stopped.

zh.Situation: 喺一間 web agency，客戶嘅 booking form 差唔多一個月都送重複查詢，客戶怪個設計。
zh.Task: 我要找出真正原因，並解釋得清楚到客戶唔再怪個 build。
zh.Action: 我用慢連線重現，發現 request 期間 submit 按鈕仍然可按，於是加咗可見狀態同停用。
zh.Result: 重複查詢停止，同時證明客戶自己嘅網絡另外有 timeout。
zh.vague: 有啲重複查詢，客戶唔滿意。
zh.exaggerated: 我證明咗客戶錯，仲自己修好晒所有嘢。
zh.no_data: 修好之後重複就冇再出現。

en.Situation: For a student society site, the events page loaded every poster image at full size on a phone.
en.Task: I offered to fix the image loading, and I had to do it without breaking the layout the committee had approved.
en.Action: I generated three sizes per poster, used a picture element, and checked the page on the committee's own phones before changing anything.
en.Result: The events page used about a fifth of the data, and the committee approved the layout unchanged.
en.vague: The page was heavy on mobile and slow to open.
en.exaggerated: I made the site faster than any commercial event platform.
en.no_data: The page was lighter afterwards and opened quicker.

zh.Situation: 學會網站嘅活動頁，喺手機上會載入全部海報原圖。
zh.Task: 我提出修好圖片載入，但唔可以改壞委員會已批嘅排版。
zh.Action: 我為每張海報出三個尺寸，用 picture element，改之前先喺委員自己嘅手機睇過。
zh.Result: 活動頁用嘅數據大約減到五分之一，排版完全冇變，委員會照批。
zh.vague: 個頁喺手機上好重，開得慢。
zh.exaggerated: 我令個站快過任何商業活動平台。
zh.no_data: 之後個頁輕咗，開得快咗。

en.Situation: Five years in, a client asked us to add live chat to their site two weeks before a campaign, and the vendor script was 300 KB.
en.Task: I had to say what was realistic, and still give them something that helped the campaign on time.
en.Action: I measured the script cost on a mobile profile, proposed loading it only on the contact page, and wrote the loading test with the team.
en.Result: The campaign launched on schedule, and the chat widget did not slow the pages people landed on.
en.vague: The client wanted a new feature quickly and it was tight.
en.exaggerated: I delivered a full chat platform two weeks early by myself.
en.no_data: We launched on time and the pages stayed fast.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，客戶要求喺 campaign 前兩星期加 live chat，而 vendor 個 script 有 300 KB。
zh.Task: 我要講清楚咩做得到，同時要畀到一樣幫到 campaign 又準時嘅嘢。
zh.Action: 我喺 mobile profile 量度 script 成本，提出只在聯絡頁載入，再同團隊一齊寫載入測試。
zh.Result: campaign 準時上線，chat widget 亦冇拖慢用戶落腳嘅頁面。
zh.vague: 客戶想快啲加新功能，時間好緊。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人提早兩星期交咗成個 chat 平台。
zh.no_data: 我哋準時上線，頁面速度都保持到。
